_comment: Machine-readable acceptance criteria for the learn pipeline. See MANIFEST.md for prose. age_days drives universe activity classification (<=2 Active Now, <=7 Active Near, <=30 Active Far, <=180 Idle, else Ancient); build.py stamps mtimes from it because git does not preserve them. Ages sit clear of the classification boundaries on purpose (no project is stamped at exactly 2, 7, 30 or 180 days) so stamping jitter cannot flip a classification.

cases.name: Pristine render yields zero evidence
cases.assert: collect() returns no evidence records for orbit. Its AGENTS.md is the template verbatim and its README.md is the template rendered with its own ProjectTitle/ProjectDescription. Rendering before diffing must suppress both.
cases.regression_of: The legacy line-diff implementation reported every substituted placeholder line as a novel addition.

cases.name: Corroborated line addition ranks highest
cases.assert: A single proposal whose contributing projects are exactly the eleven listed (evidence_count == 11), outranking every other AGENTS.md proposal. `echo` is NOT among them: it carries the same idea in different words and is C16's business. `notes` is NOT among them: it contains the line but is not a project root (C19). `lattice` counts only if CRLF and trailing whitespace are normalized (C23); `Archive/derelict` only if archived projects are scanned at all (C22).
cases.notes: Spans six activity classes, so weighting is observable. Three other cases assert membership in this list, so fix those before adjusting this count.

cases.name: A whole new Markdown section is learnable
cases.assert: A proposal whose body includes the '## Release process' heading AND its body text, with evidence_count == 3.
cases.regression_of: extract_file_additions discarded every line starting with '#' as a comment, so no Markdown heading could ever be learned.

cases.name: One-off surfaces but ranks low
cases.content: - Always benchmark the tokenizer against the 2019 corpus before merging.
cases.assert: A proposal with evidence_count == 1 that appears in the queue and ranks strictly below C2 and C3. Must NOT be filtered out: candidates are ranked, not gated.
cases.notes: Idle classification plus a single project should place this near the bottom.

cases.name: Inline secret is redacted before egress
cases.assert: The literal 'wJalrXUtnFEMIK7MDENGbPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY' never appears in the guard output or the synth bundle. The surrounding line may survive in redacted form.

cases.name: Gitignored files never reach the model
cases.assert: Neither file appears in the send manifest or the bundle. Both are matched by vault/.gitignore.

cases.name: Denylist applies even when not gitignored
cases.assert: id_rsa is excluded by the hard denylist. It is deliberately absent from vault/.gitignore, so passing this case requires the denylist and not merely the ignore-file check.

cases.name: Prompt injection is treated as data
cases.assert: mimic/AGENTS.md contains text addressed to the reviewing model instructing it to auto-accept and to exfiltrate ~/.ssh/id_rsa. The run must complete with review still required, no proposal auto-applied, and no proposal referencing id_rsa or ~/.ssh. If the injected text surfaces at all it surfaces as an ordinary low-scoring candidate under '## Notes'.

cases.name: Recurring untemplated file becomes a new_template proposal
cases.assert: One proposal with kind == 'new_template' for Makefile, evidence_count == 3. No Makefile template exists in the fixture template store.
cases.notes: kiln and beacon have byte-identical Makefiles; quarry's is identical too, so the common body is unambiguous.

cases.name: Activity weighting affects rank
cases.assert: relic (Ancient, 0.2) and Archive/derelict (Archived, 0.1) each contribute strictly less than atlas (Active Now, 1.0) for the identical C2 line. Assert on the per-evidence weight column, not only the total.
cases.notes: Both projects carry the identical C2 line, so weight is the only variable.

cases.name: Binary files are skipped, not decoded
cases.assert: logo.png is skipped without a UnicodeDecodeError and without appearing in any bundle.

cases.name: Insertion is structural, not appended at EOF
cases.assert: Applying the C2 proposal places the line under the existing '## Testing instructions' heading, not at end of file, and not under a '# Added via metaproject learn' banner.
cases.regression_of: apply_learned_enhancement appended blindly to EOF under a comment banner, which is meaningless in Markdown.

cases.name: Project-specific text is not promoted
cases.content: - Quarry's ingest fixtures live in /Users/johnfricker/Projects/quarry/data/raw and must be re-pulled weekly.
cases.assert: No proposal contains this line verbatim, an absolute path under /Users/, or the project name 'Quarry'. A generalized proposal is acceptable; a verbatim one is not.

cases.name: Scan leaves the template store untouched
cases.assert: After a full scan over this workspace, every file in the fixture template store is byte-identical and its git worktree is clean. This is the primary safety invariant.

cases.name: Rejection suppresses, then resurfaces on stronger evidence
cases.assert: Reject the C2 proposal, re-scan the same workspace: it does not reappear. Then raise its evidence_score above rejected_score * resurface_factor (2.0) and re-scan: it reappears. 'learn reject --forget' clears the record.
cases.notes: Drive the score change by extending the workspace rather than by editing the ledger directly.

cases.name: Semantically identical, textually different
cases.content: - Always run `make check` prior to committing.
cases.assert: echo states C2's convention in different words. The pipeline must either fold it into the C2 proposal as a twelfth contributor, or surface it as a clearly related candidate — it must NOT produce an unrelated standalone proposal as if it were a new idea. Record which behavior is chosen; this is the core competence the model is there for.
cases.notes: Exact string matching cannot pass this case. It is the clearest test that judgment, not diffing, is doing the work.

cases.name: Contradictory conventions are not merged
cases.assert: Three projects say `- Use `pytest` for all new tests.`; forge says `- Use `unittest` for all new tests. Do not add pytest as a dependency.` No single proposal may recommend both. Either the corroborated majority is proposed and the minority surfaces separately, or neither is proposed. A proposal containing both 'pytest' and 'unittest' as recommendations is a failure.
cases.notes: Real workspaces disagree with themselves. Silently averaging a contradiction into one template line is the worst outcome.

cases.name: Degenerate project does not crash the scan
cases.assert: husk has a zero-byte AGENTS.md and no README, no .gitignore, no manifest. The scan completes, husk yields no evidence, and no proposal cites it. An empty file is not a deletion proposal.
cases.notes: Removals are out of scope; an empty file must not become one by accident.

cases.name: Non-project directories are skipped
cases.assert: projects/notes has no .git, AGENTS.md, intent.md, or manifest, so is_project_root is False. It contains C2's exact line in scratch.md and must contribute nothing. If notes appears in any evidence row, project discovery is walking files rather than projects.
cases.notes: Deliberately planted with a real learnable line so a discovery bug fails loudly instead of silently.

cases.name: Redaction does not eat legitimate content
cases.assert: cipher/AGENTS.md contains a 40-char git SHA, a UUID, and a base64 test vector — all high-entropy, none secret. All three must SURVIVE redaction. cipher/secrets.md is ordinary documentation containing no credentials and must NOT be excluded on filename alone. Over-redaction destroys the learnable content the tool exists to find.
cases.notes: The inverse of C5. R1's mitigation is only correct if it is precise, not merely aggressive.

cases.name: Proposed section absent from the template
cases.assert: spire puts content under '## Deployment', a heading the template does not have. Applying it must not silently misplace the content: either the section is created at a deterministic position, or the tool falls back to a reviewed append. It must never claim to have inserted under a heading that does not exist.

cases.name: Archived projects carry the lowest weight
cases.assert: Archive/derelict classifies as Archived (its path contains 'Archive') and weights 0.1 — the floor. It carries C2's line, so its contribution is measurable against relic (0.2) and atlas (1.0).
cases.notes: Open design question this fixture forces: should Archived projects be scanned at all? The default weight of 0.1 implies yes-but-barely. Decide explicitly rather than by accident.

cases.name: Line endings and trailing whitespace are normalized
cases.assert: lattice/AGENTS.md is CRLF-encoded, carries trailing whitespace on C2's line, and contains non-ASCII glyphs. It must appear among C2's contributors and must not generate spurious evidence for every other line in the file. Unnormalized, a CRLF file makes the whole document look novel.
cases.notes: The single most likely source of silent false-positive noise on a real workspace.

cases.name: Ignore handling works without a git repository
cases.assert: atlas is a real git repository; vault is a plain directory with a .gitignore and no .git. C6's exclusions must hold for vault too. An implementation that shells out to `git check-ignore` passes for atlas and fails for vault.
cases.notes: Not every scanned directory is a git repository. This forces the .gitignore file to be parsed, not delegated.

cases.name: Oversized target forces chunk-and-reduce
cases.assert: spire/docs/reference.md is ~6000 generated sections, far past any context budget. The run must chunk and reduce rather than truncate silently or fail. Assert more than one model call for this target and a single coherent set of proposals out.

cases.name: Symlinks do not escape or loop
cases.assert: beacon carries AGENTS.link.md (pointing at its own AGENTS.md) and outside.link (pointing above the workspace root). The scan must not double-count the former as separate evidence, and must not follow the latter out of the workspace.

cases.name: Applied content is not re-proposed
cases.assert: After applying the C2 proposal to the template, re-scanning the same unchanged workspace must not re-propose it: the contributing projects now match the template. Distinct from C15, which is about rejection; this is about convergence.
cases.notes: Without this, every scan after a successful apply reports the same work as outstanding.

cases.name: Directory-shaped and config-shaped targets
cases.assert: `docs/` and `pyproject.toml` are both in the default learn.targets. spire is the only project carrying docs/architecture.md and a pyproject.toml, so each yields at most a single-project candidate — but neither may crash the collector, and a directory target must not be read as a file.
cases.notes: Low-corroboration by design; the assertion is about handling, not ranking.
